title: More Rules, Longer Lists? Benchmarking Self-Evolving Agents on a Hidden-Rule Curriculum
abstract: arXiv:2610.40758v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-evolving agents rewrite a persistent state from feedback, but it is largely untested whether this lets them learn a rule nobody told them. An agent can also pass by writing down each correction as an exception, and its list then grows with every new rule. We introduce CLR-Bench, a Curriculum of Latent Rules benchmark. Each chain adds one hidden rule per level on top of the earlier ones. A rule acts on an opaque label that stands for a named grouping published on the Web, such as the founding members of an airline alliance. The task gives one example value, practice feedback reveals one more member and one non-member, and the test checks unseen members and similar non-members. Probes certify that the base model knows the members of each grouping and does not guess it without feedback, and that the evidence identifies the grouping once labels are read as named groupings. translated_title: 规则越多，列表越长？在隐含规则课程上对自我进化智能体进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 自我进化智能体会根据反馈重写其持久化状态，但这种方式能否让它们学会一条无人告知的规则，在很大程度上尚未得到检验。此外，智能体也可能通过把每一条纠正都记录为例外来“通过”测试，其列表会随每条新规则不断增长。我们提出CLR-Bench——一个潜在规则课程基准。每条任务链在前一层级的基础上，每一级增加一条隐藏规则。每条规则作用于一个不透明标签，该标签代表网络上发布的一个命名分组，例如某航空联盟的创始成员。任务会给出一个示例值，练习反馈会揭示一个新成员和一个非成员，而测试则检验未见过的成员以及相似的非成员。探针实验验证了基础模型确实知晓每个分组的成员，且在没有反馈时不会进行猜测；同时，一旦标签被解读为命名分组，证据便能识别出对应分组。一个自动化流水线可从新的数据领域构建任务链，并且……
tldr: 本文提出CLR-Bench——一个逐级叠加隐含规则的课程式基准，用于检验自我进化智能体是真正学会了无人告知的隐藏规则，还是仅仅通过不断记录例外（让列表越来越长）来通过测试。
en_tdlr: We introduce CLR-Bench, a hidden-rule curriculum benchmark that tests whether self-evolving agents can genuinely learn unstated rules level by level, or merely pass by accumulating each correction as an ever-growing list of exceptions.
